# Ashley Sara

> Ashley Sara is a Search Experience Strategist based in Elko, Nevada, serving clients of every size and industry across Nevada, Utah, and Idaho. She helps businesses, nonprofits, and higher-education programs become the answer Google, ChatGPT, Gemini, and Perplexity recommend.

## Services
- SEO and AI search optimization (AEO / GEO)
- Google Ads and Meta Ads
- Web design and development
- WCAG accessibility and UX
- Content and brand strategy
- Analytics and conversion rate optimization
- AI marketing automations

## Credentials
- 10+ years in digital marketing
- Digital Marketing Specialist, Southern Utah University Graduate & Online Programs
- Founder, Ashley Sara Marketing
- Part of the SUU web team that earned a top 1% global WCAG accessibility ranking
- B.S. Strategic Communications, Magna Cum Laude, Southern Utah University
